content.short: RainbowKit provides wallet integration tools for developers.
content.description: RainbowKit is a fast, free web3 wallet integration toolkit that helps dapp developers connect users’ wallets to a dapp’s frontend UI. It lets users pick their preferred wallet, enabling smoother onboarding and a better user experience. The toolkit is used by teams such as Zora, Showtime, the Ethereum Name Service (ENS), and the Optimism Bridge. RainbowKit also supports customization through themes, wallet lists, supported chains, and configurable connect buttons.
content.meta: RainbowKit is a fast, free web3 wallet integration toolkit that helps dapps connect users' wallets. Discover RainbowKit and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
